description: Post to a subreddit on the user's behalf: a title written for that subreddit plus text, a link, or an existing post's caption and image. Reddit is never posted to automatically — only through this, and only after the user has approved subreddit, title and text. Check list_subreddits for rules and flairs first.

flairId.description: A flairId from list_subreddits, when the subreddit requires one

postId.description: An existing oriiion post to use as the source (caption + image)

text.description: Body text; defaults to the post's caption when postId is given

title.description: Title written for this subreddit, max 300 characters

url.description: Makes it a link post to this URL instead of a text/image post

name: publish_to_reddit
title: Publish To Reddit
